title.narrative: Better quality and safety of fish and fishery products for improving fish trade development in Cambodia

description.narrative: With financial support from multi-donor trade development support project, the Department of Fisheries Post-Harvest-Technologies and Quality Control (DFPTQ) under the Fisheries Administration, is implementing a project to promote better quality and safety of fish and fishery products for improving fish trade development in Cambodia. The project mainly aims to improve quality and enhance access to markets through development of technical guidelines for improving processing, quality, packaging, and safety requirements. Furthermore, the project will seek to build relevant technical competencies of relevant government agencies including competent authority at all levels of food chain including fish inspection and services to ensure that fish and fisheries products are handled, transported, marketed and processed in compliance with food safety requirements for both domestic and international markets. Given the complexity of the project and tight timeline to complete the project by August 31, 2013, the Department of Fisheries Post Harvest Technologies and Quality Control (DFPTQ) of the Fishery Administration (FiA) engages consultancy services of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) to provide technical assistance.
